mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMENT ( post_idx, member_idx, parent_comment_idx, content, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{postIdx}, #{memberIdx}, #{parentCommentIdx}, #{content}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, m.nick_name as nickName, m.profile_image_url as profileImageUrl FROM TB_COMMENT c LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON c.member_idx = m.idx WHERE c.idx = #{idx}
SELECT c.*, m.nick_name as nickName, m.profile_image_url as profileImageUrl FROM TB_COMMENT c LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON c.member_idx = m.idx WHERE c.idx = #{idx} AND c.parent_comment_idx IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.idx, c.post_idx, c.parent_comment_idx, c.member_idx, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, m.nick_name as nickName, m.profile_image_url as profileImageUrl, COUNT(DISTINCT l.idx) as likeCount, COUNT(DISTINCT u.idx) as unlikeCount, MAX(CASE WHEN l.member_idx = #{memberIdx} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as isLiked, MAX(CASE WHEN u.member_idx = #{memberIdx} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as isUnliked FROM TB_COMMENT c LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON c.member_idx = m.idx LEFT JOIN TB_LIKE l ON c.idx = l.comment_idx LEFT JOIN TB_UNLIKE u ON c.idx = u.comment_idx WHERE c.post_idx = #{postIdx} AND c.parent_comment_idx IS NULL GROUP BY c.idx, c.post_idx, c.parent_comment_idx, c.member_idx, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, m.nick_name, m.profile_image_url
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.idx) DESC, c.created_at DESC
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT u.idx) DESC, c.created_at DESC
ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE parent_comment_idx = c.idx) DESC, c.created_at DESC
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT c.idx, c.post_idx, c.parent_comment_idx, c.member_idx, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, m.nick_name as nickName, m.profile_image_url as profileImageUrl, COUNT(DISTINCT l.idx) as likeCount, COUNT(DISTINCT u.idx) as unlikeCount, MAX(CASE WHEN l.member_idx = #{memberIdx} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as isLiked, MAX(CASE WHEN u.member_idx = #{memberIdx} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as isUnliked FROM TB_COMMENT c LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON c.member_idx = m.idx LEFT JOIN TB_LIKE l ON c.idx = l.comment_idx LEFT JOIN TB_UNLIKE u ON c.idx = u.comment_idx WHERE c.parent_comment_idx = #{parentCommentIdx} GROUP BY c.idx, c.post_idx, c.parent_comment_idx, c.member_idx, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, m.nick_name, m.profile_image_url
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.idx) DESC, c.created_at DESC
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT u.idx) DESC, c.created_at DESC
ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COMMENT SET content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE idx = #{idx} AND member_idx = #{memberIdx}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE idx = #{commentIdx} AND member_idx = #{memberIdx}
